editorial:
When Mari Collingwood heads into town to hang out with her friend Paige instead of staying at her family's quiet lake house, you know things are about to go wrong. What starts as a normal night out turns into a nightmare when the girls cross paths with a group of dangerous criminals on the run. The tension builds fast, and before long, Mari's parents find themselves in a terrifying situation they never saw coming. The movie keeps you on edge from start to finish, blending family drama with raw survival horror in a way that feels grounded and real.

The acting is strong across the board, especially from the parents who carry the emotional weight of the story. The pacing rarely slows down, and the action scenes hit hard without feeling over the top. On the downside, some moments are tough to watch, so this is not for everyone. If you enjoy intense thrillers with a dark edge, you will probably get hooked. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: After the criminals break into the Collingwood lake house seeking shelter, Mari's parents slowly realize these are the same people who attacked their daughter. The twist comes when the parents turn the tables, using their home and tools to fight back against the intruders one by one. In the final scenes, Mari is found alive but badly hurt, and her parents manage to save her. The movie ends with the family together, having survived the nightmare, though forever changed by what happened.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves intense home-invasion thrillers with a dark edge.
